newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuadoreans warm to president, cool to his milk.
newsitem.headline: Ecuadoreans warm to president, cool to his milk.

text.p: An Ecuadorean firm has started selling milk named after newly elected populist President Abdala Bucaram but local media reported sales were not as good as expected.

Plastic bags of "Abdalact," which means "Abdamilk," went on sale on Sunday in shops in the port city of Guayaquil. But the new product met with a mixed response from consumers despite sporting Bucaram's smiling face on the label.

The Expreso daily blamed insufficient advertising for luke-warm sales of Abdalact. The government of Bucaram, a portly populist who wears a Charlie Chaplin style moustache and likes to jam with rock groups, is not subsidising Abdalact.
